summary: The analysis reveals a group of candidates that are powerful prognostic and predictive factors, particularly the patient-reported outcomes (e.g., physical function, pain severity). Many of these measurements serve as strong confounders. A subset of these, alongside certain pulmonary and neurological features, also exhibit signals for effect modification, primarily identified through R-learners and causal forests.
